prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: original first-party OpenTTD vehicle.model-15 SMALL MINING PROBE. FREE-FLIGHT base silhouette, four true physical directions of ONE identical compact robotic spacecraft.
No input images. Create new original bitmap art.

ONE small autonomous OLIVE-GRAY wedge-shaped central bus, ONE short cylindrical axial mining drill at its A/front end, exactly TWO small articulated hook arms flanking the drill, exactly TWO rectangular dark-blue solar paddles on opposite sides of the B/rear bus, ONE short central rear maneuvering nozzle, and ONE small yellow upper access panel. Keep these exact components/proportions in every orientation. The drill and hooks are folded closely into a compact ready-to-travel pose. The two solar paddles are small rigid rectangles, not enormous wings. Show readable chunky silhouettes and broad facets, minimal fine detail.
No person, cockpit, cab, scanner dish, cargo basket, wheels, legs, landing skids, rocket hull, big exhaust flame, asteroid or extra machinery.

FOUR genuine fixed elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC classic transport-Tycoon engine viewport headings, upper-left screen illumination:
TOP LEFT N: A/front drill points exactly UP the image, compact narrow end-on view.
TOP RIGHT NE: A/front drill points UPPER RIGHT, long axis lower-left to upper-right.
BOTTOM LEFT E: A/front drill points exactly RIGHT, elevated exact SIDE view, long axis horizontal.
BOTTOM RIGHT SE: A/front drill points LOWER RIGHT, long axis upper-left to lower-right.
Redraw genuine 3D orientations of the SAME model. Never rotate or mirror a flat picture, never rotate the light. The rear bus and solar paddles remain at the actual opposite B end in all four views.

Style: crisp, restrained classic 1990s Tycoon pixel-art clusters, low-resolution industrial game-sprite design, matte olive-gray hull with pale top facets and dark charcoal undersides, readable yellow tool/access accents and dark navy solar cells with only two or three broad blue divisions. No photorealism, soft painted gradients, smooth 3D-render sheen, outlines thicker than a small native sprite, text, logos or excessive greebles. These will reduce to about 36x24 pixels in a 64x48 native canvas. Preserve clear drill, hooks and two paddles at that tiny size.

Create a SAFE BORDERED transparent source sheet, requested1536x1024, four complete separated cutouts in2x2:
opaque PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF rectangular frames approximately6px thick:
N(24,24)-(744,488), NE(792,24)-(1512,488),
E(24,536)-(744,1000), SE(792,536)-(1512,1000).
Magenta is separator only, outside every model.
Each whole craft must fit well inside its frame with at least48px REAL TRANSPARENT clearance.
Max craft roughly450px wide,270px tall; reduce uniformly as needed.
No antenna, arm, solar paddle, nozzle, shadow or subject pixel may touch a frame, enter a gutter or another panel.
Use genuine transparent alpha throughout background, margins and gutters. Keep magenta frames opaque and visible.
No text, labels, numbers, direction letters, arrows, stars, background, floor, pedestal, cast shadow or extra props.
Four complete fully separated views of this ONE small mining probe. Safe separation and exact component identity take priority over subject size.
